You can view and download this file on Github: [reduceURDFrobotDataTest.py](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/tree/master/python/TestModels/reduceURDFrobotDataTest.py)

```{code-block} python
:linenos:

#+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
# This is an EXUDYN example
#
# Details:  urdfImport.ReduceURDFrobotData (#3372) on a dict as GetURDFrobotData returns it, an arm with a wrist and two
#           prismatic fingers, without the Robotics Toolbox: the fingers locked at given values keep the total mass, center of mass and
#           inertia of the robot and the positions of the tool and of a link after a locked joint; the removed links
#           are left out with what hangs on them; names that do not exist are refused
#
# Author:   Johannes Gerstmayr
# Date:     2026-11-08
#
# Copyright:This file is part of Exudyn. Exudyn is free software. You can redistribute it and/or modify it under the terms of the Exudyn license. See 'LICENSE.txt' for more details.
#
#+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

import exudyn as exu
from exudyn.robotics.urdfImport import ReduceURDFrobotData, RobotFromURDFdata
from exudyn.rigidBodyUtilities import RotationMatrixX, RotationMatrixZ
import exudyn.cMath as cMath
import numpy as np

testIsActive = exu.sys.get('testIsActive', False)
checks = []

def Link(name, parentName, translation, jointType, mass, com, rotation=np.eye(3)):
    preHT = np.eye(4)
    preHT[:3, :3] = rotation
    preHT[:3, 3] = translation
    return {'name': name, 'jointName': name + '_joint', 'parentName': parentName, 'preHT': preHT, 'mass': mass, 'com': np.array(com, dtype=float),
            'inertiaCOM': np.array([[0.03, 0.001, 0.002], [0.001, 0.04, 0.003], [0.002, 0.003, 0.05]])*mass, 'jointType': jointType,
            'jointLimits': [-1., 1.], 'graphicsDataList': [], 'inertiaProblems': []}

toolHT = np.eye(4)
toolHT[:3, 3] = [0.02, 0, 0.3]
linkList = [Link('arm', 'None', [0, 0, 0.2], 'Rz', 4., [0.2, 0, 0]),
            Link('wrist', 'arm', [0.4, 0, 0], 'Ry', 2., [0, 0.05, 0.1], RotationMatrixX(0.3)),
            Link('fingerA', 'wrist', [0, 0.02, 0.15], 'Py', 0.3, [0, 0.01, 0.02]),
            Link('tip', 'fingerA', [0, 0, 0.05], 'Rx', 0.1, [0, 0, 0.01], RotationMatrixZ(0.4)),
            Link('fingerB', 'wrist', [0, -0.02, 0.15], 'Py', 0.3, [0, -0.01, 0.02])]
data = {'linkList': linkList, 'numberOfJoints': 5, 'graphicsBaseList': [], 'graphicsToolList': [], 'toolHT': toolHT,
        'staticJointValues': np.zeros(5), 'staticGraphicsList': []}

def JointHT(link, q):
    T = np.eye(4)
    if link['jointType'][0] == 'P':
        T['xyz'.index(link['jointType'][1]), 3] = q
    elif link['jointType'] == 'Rz':
        T[:3, :3] = RotationMatrixZ(q)
    elif link['jointType'] == 'Rx':
        T[:3, :3] = RotationMatrixX(q)
    else:
        (c, s) = (cMath.cos(q), cMath.sin(q))
        T[:3, :3] = [[c, 0, s], [0, 1, 0], [-s, 0, c]]
    return T

def Frames(robotData, values):
    frames = {'None': np.eye(4)}
    for link in robotData['linkList']:
        frames[link['name']] = frames[link['parentName']] @ np.array(link['preHT']) @ JointHT(link, values.get(link['name'], 0.))
    return frames

def MassProperties(robotData, values):
    """total mass, center of mass and inertia at the center of mass, in the global frame, computed link by link"""
    frames = Frames(robotData, values)
    (m, mc, I) = (0., np.zeros(3), np.zeros((3, 3)))
    parts = []
    for link in robotData['linkList']:
        T = frames[link['name']]
        c = T[:3, :3] @ link['com'] + T[:3, 3]
        parts += [(link['mass'], c, T[:3, :3] @ link['inertiaCOM'] @ T[:3, :3].T)]
        m += link['mass']
        mc += link['mass']*c
    C = mc/m
    for (mi, c, Ii) in parts:
        d = c - C
        I += Ii + mi*(np.dot(d, d)*np.eye(3) - np.outer(d, d))
    return (m, C, I)

locked = {'fingerA_joint': 0.04, 'fingerB': -0.03, 'tip': 0.5} #by the name of the joint or of the link
reduced = ReduceURDFrobotData(data, lockedJoints=locked)
checks += [[link['name'] for link in reduced['linkList']] == ['arm', 'wrist'], reduced['numberOfJoints'] == 2]
checks += [reduced['linkList'][1]['parentNumber'] == 0, len(data['linkList']) == 5] #the input is not changed

qFree = {'arm': 0.7, 'wrist': -0.4}
qFull = {**qFree, 'fingerA': 0.04, 'fingerB': -0.03, 'tip': 0.5}
(m0, c0, I0) = MassProperties(data, qFull)
(m1, c1, I1) = MassProperties(reduced, qFree)
checks += [abs(m0 - m1) < 1e-14, np.max(np.abs(c0 - c1)) < 1e-14, np.max(np.abs(I0 - I1)) < 1e-14]

#locking only the upper finger joint: the tip is attached to the wrist, in the same place
reducedTip = ReduceURDFrobotData(data, lockedJoints={'fingerA': 0.04})
checks += [reducedTip['linkList'][2]['name'] == 'tip' and reducedTip['linkList'][2]['parentName'] == 'wrist']
framesFull = Frames(data, qFull)
framesTip = Frames(reducedTip, qFull)
checks += [np.max(np.abs(framesFull['tip'] - framesTip['tip'])) < 1e-14]

#the tool, relative to the wrist that is now the last link, at zero joint values
zeroFull = Frames(data, {})
checks += [np.max(np.abs(zeroFull['wrist'] @ reduced['toolHT'] - zeroFull['fingerB'] @ toolHT)) < 1e-14]

#removed links go with what hangs on them; their mass is gone
removed = ReduceURDFrobotData(data, removedLinks=['fingerA'])
checks += [[link['name'] for link in removed['linkList']] == ['arm', 'wrist', 'fingerB']]
checks += [abs(sum(link['mass'] for link in removed['linkList']) - 6.3) < 1e-14]

for arguments in [{'lockedJoints': {'noLink': 0.}}, {'removedLinks': ['noLink']}, {'lockedJoints': {'tip': 0.}, 'removedLinks': ['fingerA']}]:
    try:
        ReduceURDFrobotData(data, **arguments)
        checks += [False]
    except ValueError:
        checks += [True]

#a Robot from the reduced data has the two joints and the tool
robot = RobotFromURDFdata(reduced)
checks += [robot.NumberOfLinks() == 2]
tool = np.array(robot.GetGlobalToolHT(np.zeros(2)).HT44())
checks += [np.max(np.abs(tool - zeroFull['wrist'] @ reduced['toolHT'])) < 1e-14]

u = sum(checks) + sum(I1.flatten()) + sum(c1)
exu.Print('checks:', checks)
exu.Print('solution of reduceURDFrobotDataTest=', u)
exu.sys['testResult'] = u
```
